intro: Can you trust what you see?
description:
Some rumors sound too strange to be true... but that is exactly what makes you want to check.

We have all heard a story that someone swore was real. When the clue is an image, can you tell what actually adds up?

This is a 4-choice image quiz with an urban-mystery mood: quick questions, surprising explanations, and a casual pace that makes it easy to keep going.

・Look closely at the image
・Compare the 4 choices
・Choose the answer that seems most convincing
・Read the explanation after you answer

Getting it right feels great, but even a miss can teach you a fun new angle.

Play a round whenever you have a few minutes, and see how well you can separate rumor from reality.
